items.title: A base change of a DM morphism along a DM stack or an algebraic space admits a surjective etale cover by a scheme
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project — Morphisms of Algebraic Stacks
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file stacks-morphisms.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that for a DM morphism of algebraic stacks the base change along any morphism from a DM stack, or from an algebraic space, admits a scheme mapping onto it by a surjective etale morphism (author lemma at source lines 4745-4759, label lemma-DM). The proof (source lines 4761-4774) base changes the morphism, uses the permanence statements for DM-ness to conclude that the base-changed stack is DM, and applies the characterization of DM stacks through etale presentations, with the algebraic space case reduced to the first assertion (proof lines 4761-4772). The combination of base change permanence with the DM characterization is the content. H2.
